Sertraline, a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI), is a known treatment for OCD and anxiety disorders, further reinforcing the link between Citalopram and Anxiety Disorder. The final score of 0.6706 indicates a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, supported by the sequential indications and off-label use.
